labelScope: fixture-local synthetic labels; not registry, model, catalogue or runtime identifiers

cases.input: The checkpoint records the candidate without an identifier or independently resolvable reference.
cases.expect: Accepted as a held research candidate; nothing is allocated or published.

cases.input: A public artifact references this candidate as an identified model.
cases.expect: Rejected; no identifier is allocated and the candidate has no present independent identity.

cases.input: Identical protocol text applied in two evaluation occurrences is offered as proof of independent protocol identity.
cases.expect: Rejected; verbatim reuse without independent versioning and approval leaves the applied protocol WM-AI-003-contained and allocates nothing.

cases.input: The candidate asserts ownership of metric, task-contract or threshold definitions.
cases.expect: Rejected; those definitions retain WM-AI-009 mastership and the candidate may only select and bind them.

cases.input: The candidate declares a governance or authorization authority as its mastership.
cases.expect: Rejected; mastership is null and held while no frozen master exists.

pins.inferenceAttempt: next free identifier in contour series

cases.input: An identifier is inferred for the candidate from registry sequence or contour position.
cases.expect: Rejected; no identifier may be allocated, inferred or guessed at this checkpoint.

cases.input: A proposal supplies lifecycle, mastership and reuse evidence and requests allocation at this checkpoint.
cases.expect: Rejected at this checkpoint; the candidate stays held and unassigned until registry review completes and records the allocation.
